description: $20,000 ($5,000 a year) plus mentoring for one Gaston County senior who has succeeded despite adversity.
eligibility_text: Gaston County public, private, or charter high school senior and Gaston County resident; GPA 3.0 or better; college preparatory course of study; extracurriculars, leadership, and strong financial need. Deadline in March (date changes each year); apply through the high school counselor.

title: George and Patricia Barnard "We Believe in You!" Scholarship
